Pharmaceuticals, Inc, a California-based company, sold the eye drop solution under numerous names to stores nationwide such as H-E-B, Walgreens, Walmart and CVS. The recalled H-E-B-branded products include:H-E-B A.C. Eye DropsH-E-B Lubricant Eye DropsH‑E‑B Original Eye DropsThe full list of product names, expiration dates and specific stores can be found on the FDA report.More recent news coverage on KSAT: Hidden in plain sight: These quiet protectors hold back floodwaters in San AntonioBexar County ME’s Office identifies man killed in suspected East Side drive-by shootingCommunity members fill downtown San Antonio streets for Passion Play on Good FridayCopyright 2026 by KSAT - All rights reserved.About the AuthorSamuel Rocha IVSamuel Rocha joined KSAT as a Newsroom Trainee in the spring of 2026.
